name: vscode-musi
description: Musi language support for VS Code, including syntax highlighting, LSP diagnostics, hover, semantic tokens, formatting, and package commands.

commands.title: Run Current Package
commands.description: Run the entry declared by the owning musi.json.

commands.title: Check Current Package
commands.description: Refresh diagnostics for the package that owns the active file.

commands.title: Build Current Package
commands.description: Build the package that owns the active file.

commands.title: Test Current Package
commands.description: Run tests for the package that owns the active file.

commands.title: Run Package Task
commands.description: Choose and run a task from the owning musi.json.

commands.title: Select Run Configuration
commands.description: Choose a named Musi run configuration.

commands.title: Run Current Package with Arguments
commands.description: Prompt for runtime arguments and run the package entry.

commands.title: Edit Run Configurations
commands.description: Open Musi run configuration settings.

commands.title: Format Document
commands.description: Format the active Musi or Markdown document.

commands.title: Open Command Center
commands.description: Open the Musi command center for package, workspace, editor, and language-server actions.

commands.title: Restart Language Server
commands.description: Restart musi_lsp and refresh editor analysis.

commands.title: Start Language Server
commands.description: Start musi_lsp for hover, references, completion, semantic tokens, formatting, and inlay hints.

commands.title: Stop Language Server
commands.description: Stop musi_lsp and use fallback diagnostics where available.

commands.title: Show Language Server Output
commands.description: Open the Musi language-server log output.

commands.title: Check Workspace
commands.description: Run diagnostics across all workspace members.

commands.title: Build Workspace
commands.description: Build every package in the workspace.

commands.title: Test Workspace
commands.description: Run tests across every workspace member.

commands.title: Format Workspace
commands.description: Format every Musi source file in the workspace.

commands.title: Configure Inlay Hints
commands.description: Choose Musi parameter-name and inferred-type hint behavior.

commands.title: Show Status
commands.description: Show current Musi language-server, diagnostics, and package status.

musi.cliPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `musi` CLI. Leave as `musi` to use workspace build outputs, Cargo bin, then PATH.
musi.cliPath.description: CLI used for package commands, fallback diagnostics, formatting, builds, tests, and runs.

musi.lspPath.markdownDescription: Path to `musi_lsp`. Leave as `musi_lsp` to use workspace build outputs, Cargo bin, then PATH.
musi.lspPath.description: Language server used for hover, references, semantic tokens, completion, formatting, and inlay hints.

musi.lsp.enabled.description: Use the language server for editor intelligence when a Musi source file opens.

musi.checkOnSave.description: Keeps diagnostics useful before the language server starts or when it is stopped.
musi.checkOnSave.markdownDescription: Run fallback `musi check` diagnostics on save when the language server is unavailable, and keep manifest diagnostics active.

musi.hover.maximumLength.description: Raise this when inspecting long generated types; lower it for compact hovers.
musi.hover.maximumLength.markdownDescription: Maximum hover Markdown length before the language server truncates the response.

musi.inlayHints.enabled.description: Master switch for parameter-name and inferred-type hints.
musi.inlayHints.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable Musi inlay hints from the language server.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Show parameter-name hints for literal-like arguments.
Show parameter-name hints for all positional arguments.
musi.inlayHints.parameterNames.enabled.description: Parameter-name hints make positional calls easier to scan.
musi.inlayHints.parameterNames.enabled.markdownDescription: Controls call-site parameter-name hints. `literals` mirrors Rust Analyzer style by hinting values that need context.

musi.inlayHints.parameterNames.suppressW.markdownDescription: Hide parameter-name hints when the argument text already names the same concept.

musi.inlayHints.variableTypes.enabled.description: Useful while designing APIs or reviewing stdlib code.
musi.inlayHints.variableTypes.enabled.markdownDescription: Show inferred type hints for bindings without explicit type annotations.

musi.inlayHints.variableTypes.suppressWh.description: Reduces redundant hints in well-named declarations.
musi.inlayHints.variableTypes.suppressWh.markdownDescription: Hide inferred type hints when the binding name already carries the same type information.

musi.runtime.args.description: Applies to command-center run actions and named run configurations.
musi.runtime.args.markdownDescription: Runtime arguments appended after `--` when running the owning package entry.

musi.runtime.env.description: Merged with env files and per-run-configuration environment values.
musi.runtime.env.markdownDescription: Environment variables added to Musi package commands.

musi.runtime.envFile.markdownDescription: Path to an env file, resolved relative to the owning package root unless absolute.
musi.runtime.envFile.description: Use this for package-local environment without putting values in settings JSON.

musi.runtime.cwd.description: Defaults to the package root discovered from the active file.
musi.runtime.cwd.markdownDescription: Working directory for package commands, resolved relative to the owning package root unless absolute.

musi.terminal.clearBeforeRun.description: Keeps repeated command-center runs easy to read.
musi.terminal.clearBeforeRun.markdownDescription: Clear the Musi terminal before sending a command.

musi.terminal.focusOnRun.description: Turn off for background build/test workflows.
musi.terminal.focusOnRun.markdownDescription: Focus the integrated terminal when a Musi command starts.

musi.terminal.reuseTerminal.description: Keeps command history in one terminal tab.
musi.terminal.reuseTerminal.markdownDescription: Reuse the existing Musi terminal for package commands.

entry.description: Package entry override passed to `musi run`.

cliArgs.description: Extra CLI arguments inserted before the entry argument.

env.description: Environment variables merged into the package command environment.

envFile.description: Env file path resolved from the owning package root unless absolute.

cwd.description: Working directory override resolved from the owning package root unless absolute.

preLaunchTask.description: Task name from the owning `musi.json` to run before the package entry.

musi.runConfigurations.markdownDescription: Named package-entry run configurations shown by the command center.
musi.runConfigurations.description: Use these for common entries, runtime arguments, env files, working directories, and pre-launch tasks.
